body.p: This command sets and queries HTTP header information.
<id>: Mandatory parameter. Client instance created by the AT+HTTPCREATE command.
<header>: Optional parameter. Header information to be configured.
<encode_method>: Optional parameter. Specifies whether the format of the <header> parameter is escaped characters or hexadecimal ASCII code.
The HTTP protocol requires that header fields be separated by \r\n.
When the input header field is empty, all previously configured headers shall be cleared.
When the input header field is not empty, the newly input header(s) shall be appended after the previously configured header(s).

// Example 1: Add header information to the HTTP instance with ID 0. The input encoding is hexadecimal ASCII.
AT+HTTPHEADER=0,6170692D6B65793A4A4459694B794B6669344934734F4657654A0d0a,1
//Example 2: Append header information to the HTTP instance with ID 0. The input encoding is escaped characters.
// Example 3: Query the configured header information
// Example 4: Delete all configured header information (an empty <header> parameter clears all previously configured headers).
